name: Hugging Face Hub
summary: Fetch datasets and files from the Hugging Face Hub into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3; a token reaches gated and private datasets.

fields.name: access_token
fields.label: Access token
fields.help: Created in your Hugging Face account settings. Store it with ogun secrets set.

egress.note: Large files are served from CDN hosts that the Hub redirects to and that can change. Add any other host the first run reports.

notes: Uses the builtin hf@1 adapter for datasets and acquire@1 for single files. A gated dataset needs a token from an account that has accepted the dataset's terms. Each dataset carries its own licence; check it before use or redistribution.
